crossRefs.note: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.

parallels.note: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

people.name: Arpachshad
people.line: Son of Shem, ancestor of Abraham

people.name: Eber
people.line: Ancestor of Abraham; father of Peleg and Joktan

people.name: Shelah
people.line: Son of Arpachshad and ancestor of Abraham

translations.web: Arpachshad became the father of Shelah. Shelah became the father of Eber.
translations.bsb: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.
translations.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Salah; and Salah begat Eber.
translations.asv: And Arpachshad begat Shelah; and Shelah begat Eber.
